newsitem.title: CHINA: IDEAL PACIFIC IN TALKS TO BUY TOLL ROADS.
newsitem.headline: IDEAL PACIFIC IN TALKS TO BUY TOLL ROADS.

text.p: Sea freight transporter Ideal Pacific Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to buy toll road projects in China's Zhejiang province.

"The company has had preliminary discussions with an independent third party...in respect of a possible acquisition by the company of interests in certain toll road projects located in the province of Zhejiang," the company said in a statement.
The third party is a private company incorporated in Hong Kong owned by two individuals who may or may not have a China background, the statement said.
"The parties are now discussing various details of the proposed acquisition including...the consideration which may or may not involve the issue of new shares," it said.
"In case the consideration comprises of the issue of new shares, the board currently expects that such new shares will be less than 35 percent of the issue share capital of the company," it said.
Ideal Pacific said its chairman Ip Man Man, controlling 55 percent of the company, was expected to continue to be the largest shareholder even after the share issue.
The company said no agreement had yet been signed and it would make a further statement when appropriate.
Its shares gained HK$0.05 to HK$1.68 in early trade.
